The *Kilesagocchaka* (Patthana 14.25) is a structural section belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka in the Pali canon. Like other sections of the *Paṭṭhāna*, it articulates the system of conditional relations applied to a specific group of dhammas—here the cluster of dyads (*gocchaka*) treating the defilements (*kilesa*). While the title appears frequently across modern editions and translations, the secondary literature passages gathered in the search dossier exclusively pertain to the *Kilesagocchaka* of the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī* rather than this section of the *Paṭṭhāna*.
